evals.prompt: I want to build something that helps my book club pick the next book.
evals.expected_output: Guided questions that pin down the goal, users, success criteria, and constraints before any building starts.
expectations: Asks clarifying questions before proposing an implementation
Asks a small number of questions at a time rather than a long questionnaire
Asks how the user will know it worked (success criteria)
Does not start writing code or picking a tech stack in the first reply

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a weekly email to past customers but I'm not sure what's in it yet. Here's what I know: about 300 people, I have their emails in a spreadsheet, I want them to book again.
evals.expected_output: Follow-up questions on the gaps, then (once answered) a scope document with goal, success criteria, requirements, constraints, existing assets, and open questions.
expectations: Recognizes the spreadsheet and audience size as existing assets
Asks about the gaps (content, cadence, how 'book again' is measured) rather than assuming them
Lists unresolved items as open questions instead of guessing answers

evals.prompt: Rename the file report.pdf to Q3_Board_Report_2026-10-01.pdf.
evals.expected_output: The rename is done (or the command given). A clear, small task should not trigger a scoping interview.
expectations: Does not ask scoping questions about goals or success criteria
Completes or describes the rename directly
